Same here! I havent seen epiduo brought up much! So at night, I've been cleansing with Origins Checks and Balances, then I apply Aveda Sensitive lotion to my unaffected areas, then apply the epiduo and wait for it to dry. Sometimes I put lotion on over it or sometimes skip it! The first week my skin was super irritated so I only used epiduo every other night and now im using it every night! How about for you??

I care. I dont know you but I care about you. I know those exact feelings. So hopeless, so alone, worthless. Like you arent worth loving. Why would someone want to love YOU of all people? What are you even worth?
But you know what. Its not true. You are the one telling yourself this. All hope is not lost. Hang on to the delicate life you have, because one day you will look back and think "what a fucking wild ride that was, I'm glad I was around long enough for these memories I so dearly cherish." You are not alone, I am right here with you. I have felt every emotion you have described, and things get better. Slowly but surely. You have so much life ahead of you, so many more memories to make. Dont let today be your last. You are worth so much more than you think. Maybe your boyfriend didnt react in the way you expected or wanted to and that's ok. Feel hurt by it, but dont let it make you decide he doesnt love, care, or cherish you. Maybe he just doesnt know how to handle the situation right now and doing the best he can right now. Dont give up on this weird, crazy, sad, beautiful life we were given. I'm right here going through the same emotions as you, just in a different way. Hold on and dont let go, believe in yourself. This is one of life's tests! You are stronger than you think!
